_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Imreoirí Surround ar grid {width}x{height}.
Tú an imreoir {player_id}. Gluaiseachtaí bailí: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' nó w/s/a/d.
Cuspóir: maireann tú níos faide ná gach duine eile. Tá conairí marfach; maraíonn buailte balla; maraíonn buailte ceann ar cheann an bheirt.

game_action.invalid_death: Fuair an t-imreoir {player_id} bás mar gheall ar ghluaiseacht neamhbhailí.

outcome.survived_win: D'éirigh leis an imreoir {player_id} maireachtáil; thit gach duine eile.
outcome.all_crashed: Thit gach imreoir ag an am céanna.
outcome.turn_limit: Tá an teorainn casadh bainte amach - buaíonn an duine is faide a mhair.
